coordinate_system: uniform Cartesian (x,y,z) box [-a,a]^2 x [z_min,z_max) inscribed in the finite cylinder of the source checkpoints
description: Independent uniform-Cartesian audit of the saved hou_early_time_v1 checkpoints at t=0 and t=T_1 for all three radial resolutions: E-02 divergence, E-18b full curl, and the omega^theta = r*omega1 azimuthal agreement, each reported absolutely and relative to documented gradient denominators, on two audit resolutions so that audit truncation is separated from a snapshot defect. Audit box: half_width 0.7 is the largest round value whose corners stay inside the source cylinder, since 0.7*sqrt(2)=0.98995 < r_max=1.0; the axial extent is the full z period [0,1) with the endpoint omitted because z is periodic. Fine audit shape 64x64x128 gives dx=dy=1.4/63=0.0222 and dz=1/128=0.0078, which is coarser than the nr193 source spacing dr=1/192=0.0052, so the coarse companion shape 32x32x64 exists solely to expose that truncation by refinement.
interpretation: This is an independent re-derivation of three kinematic identities from saved arrays, on a finite Cartesian grid in binary64 with tolerances. It certifies neither the continuum solution nor any discretization error bound, and it is not evidence for or against singularity formation. The primitive momentum residual is NOT evaluated here: see primitive_navier_stokes_residual_gap in the summary.
